title: Why Sleep Is More Than Rest

paragraphs.en: Sleep was long dismissed as nothing more than downtime between periods of activity. Over the past two decades, however, researchers have discovered that sleeping brains are remarkably busy, performing work that waking minds cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 睡眠长期被简单地视为活动之间的休息时间。然而在过去二十年里，研究人员发现，睡眠中的大脑异常忙碌，正在完成清醒大脑无法完成的工作。

paragraphs.en: One of its most important tasks is housekeeping. During deep sleep, the brain clears away waste products that accumulate between days, including proteins associated with Alzheimer's disease.
paragraphs.zh: 它最重要的任务之一是打扫卫生。在深度睡眠期间，大脑会清除日间积累的代谢废物，其中包括与阿尔茨海默病相关的蛋白质。

paragraphs.en: Sleep also consolidates memory. Information gathered during the day is replayed, sorted and woven into existing knowledge, which is why students who sleep well before exams tend to perform better.
paragraphs.zh: 睡眠还会巩固记忆。白天收集的信息会被重放、分类，并编织进已有的知识体系中，这解释了为什么考前睡眠充足的学生往往表现更好。

paragraphs.en: The consequences of cutting sleep short extend far beyond feeling tired. Chronic sleep loss is linked to obesity, diabetes, heart disease and weakened immunity, and it impairs judgement much like alcohol does.
paragraphs.zh: 缩短睡眠时间的后果远不止感到疲倦。长期睡眠不足与肥胖、糖尿病、心脏病和免疫力下降有关，而且它会像酒精一样损害判断力。

paragraphs.en: Yet modern life works against sleep. Artificial light, endless entertainment and the habit of checking phones at midnight push bedtime later and later, while alarm clocks keep wake-up time fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 然而现代生活却与睡眠背道而驰。人造光源、无穷无尽的娱乐内容以及午夜刷手机的习惯，把就寝时间越推越晚，而闹钟却让起床时间保持不变。

paragraphs.en: The remedy does not require a drug, only discipline. A regular schedule, a dark cool room and leaving screens outside the bedroom remain the most effective sleep medicine ever found.
paragraphs.zh: 解药不需要药物，只需要自律。规律的作息、黑暗凉爽的卧室以及把手机屏幕留在卧室之外，依然是有史以来最有效的安眠药。
